underlying_goal: Implement a legacy search engine reverse-sync feature in a hexagonal architecture codebase, including domain models, mappers, API clients, caching layers, and feature toggles, then verify correctness of the CDC-to-legacy API field mapping against actual legacy API specs.
friction_detail: Build failures due to missing module dependencies in generated build.gradle.kts files, and the legacy data mapper included unnecessary fields not matching the actual legacy API spec.
brief_summary: User asked to implement a legacy search reverse-sync plan across many modules; Claude orchestrated parallel agents, fixed build issues, and was then asked to audit the field mapping accuracy against actual legacy API specs — work was mostly achieved but the mapping review was still in progress at session end.
